blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — With hotter temperatures and increased fire risks expected during the El Niño phenomenon, the Mandaue City Fire Station has started inspecting fire hydrants across the city to ensure they can provide adequate water during emergencies. Fire Officer 1 Arjim Mendaros said the inspections aim to assess the condition, location, and water pressure of fire hydrants in different areas. Initial inspections found several hydrants with weak water flow, while others had strong water pressure.
